items.title: SJM or KRYAY: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
items.summary: In a comparison of two Food - Miscellaneous sector stocks, Smucker (SJM) emerges as the superior value option over Kerry Group PLC (KRYAY). SJM has a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) with a forward P/E of 12.25 and Value grade of B, while KRYAY has a Zacks Rank of #4 (Sell) with a forward P/E of 19.70 and Value grade of D. SJM's improving earnings outlook and stronger valuation metrics make it the more attractive choice for value investors.
